scenario: A 70-year-old woman on four active medications, two of which are different ACE inhibitors (lisinopril and enalapril) prescribed at separate visits and never reconciled.
instruction: Review the patient's currently active medications and detect any duplicate or overlapping therapy — two or more active medications from the same pharmacologic class that together constitute a therapeutic duplication. Report each duplication as a flag with a severity, a description naming the specific medications involved, and evidence citing the relevant MedicationRequest resources. If there is no duplication, return an empty flag list.
